name: Ca song nuong
summary: Grilled Trachurus. The specialty-seafood account seasons it with salt and chili and wraps the meat in rice paper with herbs and vegetables. The nature account names the same plate for lunch or dinner by the water and prints no seasoning. A price is Check on arrival.
origin: Phu Quoc. Both accounts are Vietnam National Authority of Tourism.
texture: The specialty-seafood account says the meat is meatier than other seafood and tastes less fishy. It also says the fish is challenging to catch.
taste: Salt and chili, then aromatic and sweet, on the specialty-seafood account. The nature account does not print a seasoning.
howToEat: Grill it on charcoal, season with salt and chili, and wrap it with herbs and vegetables in rice paper. That is the specialty-seafood account.
Lunch or dinner by the water on the nature account. No beach was named. A price is Check on arrival.
where: By the water. No beach was named for this plate. Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Ca song nuong — grilled Trachurus on Phu Quoc
seoDescription: Cá sòng nướng is grilled Trachurus with salt and chili, eaten in rice paper. No beach was named. A price is Check on arrival.
